transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Good to meet you too. Well, I came in today because... for the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite. It's been weird. Even the foods I usually really like after a long shift, they just sit there in front of me. I end up having to just force down a few bites. It's just not normal for me, so I figured I should get it checked out.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I suppose I have. Most days, I just feel like I’m carrying this... heavy, flat feeling around with me. It’s like, even when I’m home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I’m just not really there.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to my morning runs, playing guitar, or even just cooking dinner. But lately, I just keep skipping them. They just feel like chores now, and I can't really get myself to care about doing them anymore.
How have you been sleeping lately?
My sleep hasn't really changed, honestly. I've been sleeping about the same as I usually do. I haven't noticed any issues with falling asleep or staying asleep, or anything like that.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I'm not planning to hurt myself, no. But... I guess I do keep having these thoughts lately. Just thinking that maybe it wouldn't be the worst thing if I just didn't wake up. Like, if I didn't have to keep pushing through all this every single day. I don't have a plan to do anything, it's just... a thought that keeps crossing my mind.
Have you been feeling worthless or like a burden lately?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel worthless... and I don't think I'm a burden to anyone. I mean, I know I'm struggling a bit with my motivation right now, but I don't feel like I'm useless or dragging other people down. I just haven't really had those specific kinds of thoughts.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual lately?

Yeah, actually. At work, some of the guys have pointed out that I'm moving slower during our shift briefings. And I guess I'm taking longer to answer when people talk to me. It just feels like my body and my mouth are a step behind everybody else right now.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yeah, I have. It's been pretty noticeable at work. When I'm watching the CCTV feeds or trying to write up my incident reports, my mind just kind of... drifts off. I end up having to reread the same sentence over and over again just to get through it. It's frustrating because I've actually been making some mistakes lately that I normally wouldn't make, just because I can't seem to stay focused.
Have these symptoms been going on nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah, pretty much every day. I'd say it's been going on for about three weeks now. It all really started right around the time the casino reorganized our security operations and changed up my assignments.
Do you feel these symptoms started because of the changes in your work assignment?

I mean... I'm not really sure if that's what caused it. The timing definitely lines up with the reorganization, but I don't know for a fact if the job changes actually triggered all this. It's just right around when I started noticing it, you know?
Have you lost any weight since this started?

Yeah, I probably have lost a little weight. Honestly, that's a big part of why I came in, because for the last few weeks, I've barely had an appetite at all. It's just... even the foods I usually like to grab after a shift, they just sit there in front of me. I end up having to force down a few bites just to get something in my stomach.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or on edge lately?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I've been feeling anxious or on edge. Just... mostly what I was saying before. Just feeling down and not wanting to eat. But no, no real anxiety or anything like that.
